about.title: About me
about.text: As a certified Full Stack Developer (RNCP Title Level 6 – INSTA Paris), I like to think of a project as a system: from data architecture to user experience, including business logic. I design web applications from start to finish, with the aim of structuring and industrializing my developments—tests, CI/CD, best practices. Curious and rigorous, I spend a good part of my free time exploring new tools and deepening my personal projects, always with the idea to put this requirement at the service of a team and concrete projects.
